evidence_policy: Paths refer to the original repository evidence, not this isolated worktree. Checksums anchor the review-time files; source commits permanently anchor task YAMLs and scorer. Native references remain references and final formal failures remain failures. No semantic change, budget adjustment or health-goal adaptation is made here. Any later semantic change requires explicit invalidation of the old qualification for that changed condition, not silent reuse. Offline synthetic tests are integration checks, never native qualification.
